تستطعن (form X)
# تَسْتَطِعْنَ (tastaṭiʕna) /tas.ta.tˤiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطَاعَ (istaṭāʕa)
# تُسْتَطَعْنَ (tustaṭaʕna) /tus.ta.tˤaʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطَاعَ (istaṭāʕa)
